description: Implement four missing repository implementations (HouseholdRepositoryImpl, TenantTransferRepositoryImpl, IoTDeviceIsolationRepositoryImpl, InvoiceRepositoryImpl) and register them in the DI container
steps: Create src/infrastructure/repositories/household/HouseholdRepositoryImpl.ts implementing IHouseholdRepository. Use factory function pattern with prismaClient dependency. Implement all methods: findById, exists, findWithHead, getMembers, findHead, isUserMember, isUserHead, findByUserId, findResidentById, getResidentHouseholdId, validateTenantOwnership, validateResidentHouseholdTenant. Map Prisma Household/Resident to domain entities. Return DomainResult<T> where specified.

Create src/infrastructure/repositories/transfer/TenantTransferRepositoryImpl.ts implementing ITenantTransferRepository. Implement: create, findById, findPendingByTenant, findPendingByTargetUser, hasPendingTransfer, findByTenant, findExpiredPendingTransfers, updateStatus, completeTransferAtomic. Use prismaClient.$transaction for atomic membership swap in completeTransferAtomic.

Create src/infrastructure/repositories/iot/IoTDeviceIsolationRepositoryImpl.ts implementing IIoTDeviceIsolationRepository. Implement: findById, exists, findWithContext, findByHousehold, isUserHouseholdMember, isUserHouseholdHead, findByUserId, getDeviceOrgUnitId, findByOrgUnit, validateTenantOwnership, validateDeviceHouseholdTenant, getDeviceHouseholdId. Query across IoTDevice/Household/Resident joins.

Create src/infrastructure/repositories/billing/InvoiceRepositoryImpl.ts implementing IInvoiceRepository. Implement: create, findById, findByIdempotencyKey, update, findByTenantId, findLatestBySubscription, findPendingOverdue, findOverdueExceedingGracePeriod, findDueForRetry, findUnpaidBySubscription, updateStatus, incrementRetryCount, countByStatus, getTotalAmountInPeriod, delete. Handle Prisma Decimal to number conversion.

Update src/infrastructure/di/registry/repositoryContainer.ts: add imports for all four new repository implementations, then add DI registrations: householdRepository, transferRepository, iotDeviceIsolationRepository, invoiceRepository (all as singleton factories).
Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify all implementations compile without errors.
acceptance_criteria: HouseholdRepositoryImpl.ts exists and implements all IHouseholdRepository methods with correct return types
TenantTransferRepositoryImpl.ts exists and implements all ITenantTransferRepository methods including atomic transaction for completeTransferAtomic
IoTDeviceIsolationRepositoryImpl.ts exists and implements all IIoTDeviceIsolationRepository methods with proper tenant isolation
InvoiceRepositoryImpl.ts exists and implements all IInvoiceRepository methods with proper DomainResult returns
repositoryContainer.ts imports all four implementations and registers them with correct DI keys
npx tsc --noEmit passes with exit code 0
findings: All four repository implementations created and registered in DI container. The codebase has 81 preexisting TypeScript errors related to PrismaClient import from @prisma/client (affects entire project, not just new files). This appears to be a Prisma v7 migration issue where the generated client location/exports have changed. My 4 new files follow the same pattern as existing repositories and only contribute 4 of those 81 errors. All other TypeScript errors in the new files were resolved (unused imports, implicit any types).
